onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/properties/orbit.schema.json, set orb_c_distance to {{orb_c_distance}}]
Set orbit distance preset for ThirdPersonCamera: close=targetDistance 4, standard=8, wide=14.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/properties/orbit.schema.json, set orb_c_shoulder to {{orb_c_shoulder}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.shoulderOffset: centered=0, left=-1.0, right=1.0.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/properties/orbit.schema.json, set orb_t_distance to {{orb_t_distance}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.targetDistance to {{orb_t_distance}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/properties/orbit.schema.json, set orb_t_height to {{orb_t_height}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.shoulderHeight to {{orb_t_height}} world units above the player.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/properties/orbit.schema.json, set orb_t_offset to {{orb_t_offset}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.shoulderOffset to {{orb_t_offset}}. Positive=over right shoulder.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/properties/orbit.schema.json, set orb_t_default_pitch to {{orb_t_default_pitch}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.defaultPitch to {{orb_t_default_pitch}} degrees. Negative=looking slightly down.
